scope: Continuous conditional model domain, not an observational theta_Bn interval or covariance region.
method: Exact rational power-to-Bernstein transform; midpoint de Casteljau subdivision gives a covering 8x4x8 partition. Positive coefficients bound each polynomial over the entire cell.
entropy: Reuse the R93 algebraic dp2/dh=2*M*(r-1)^3/W^2>0 and perpendicular gas-Hugoniot lower bound. M,W remain positive on the enlarged domain; therefore the same positive entropy bound applies.
angle_mapping: A=2*M*(1-t)^2/(r*W); dA/dh=-4*M*(1-t)*(2*r+1-t*(4-r))/W^2<0 for t<1, because the last factor >=3*(r-1)>0. h increases and A decreases; theta=atan(sqrt(A/h)) decreases continuously from 90 to 0 degrees.
actual_regular_fast_angle_domain: 0<theta<=90 degrees under this normalized input domain; 83.3 degrees is not a physical cutoff.
endpoint: theta=0,t=1 is a switch-on/characteristic degeneracy. It remains UNRESOLVED as an ordinary class. Numerical guard neighborhoods remain UNRESOLVED even where the exact open-domain proof applies.
other_regular_families: For M>0 and 1<r<2.5, physical non-fast quadratic completions have 1/r<h<h_pole<1 and reverse Bt. They cross the normal Alfven characteristic and fail the necessary unrestricted transverse evolutionary test. A slow state requires h>1 where A<0. This excludes regular slow only under the stated inputs/flow, not observationally.
